origin.usage: strip_ctl(x, ctl = "all", warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), strip)
origin.details: all removes every known control. Combined with other names, all means all but those names. An empty ctl removes nothing. strip is the old name of ctl.
origin.example: cat('strip_ctl(moon) returns ', strip_ctl("hello\033k\033[45p world\n\033[31mgoodbye\a moon"), ".\n", sep="")

translation.details: all removes every known control. Combined with other names, all means all but those names. An empty ctl removes nothing. strip is the old name of ctl. A string is a length-one vector, and None is a missing string.
translation.example:
from fansi import strip_ctl
print("strip_ctl(moon) returns %s." % strip_ctl("hello\x1bk\x1b[45p world\n\x1b[31mgoodbye\a moon")[0])
